stem.text: The diagrams show skeletal formulas of some isomers of $\text{C}_6\text{H}_{12}\text{O}$.

stem.alt: skeletal formula, isomer 1: unbranched six-carbon zig-zag chain with C=O at the right-hand end, CH3CH2CH2CH2CH2CHO
skeletal formula, isomer 2: C=O group with a methyl on the left, a CH bearing a methyl below, and an ethyl group on the right, CH3COCH(CH3)CH2CH3
skeletal formula, isomer 3: CHO group on a carbon bearing a methyl branch, followed by a propyl chain, CH3CH2CH2CH(CH3)CHO
skeletal formula, isomer 4: C=O group flanked by an ethyl group on the left and a propyl group on the right, CH3CH2COCH2CH2CH3

A.text: 1 and 3 are chain isomers of each other and positional isomers of each other.

B.text: 2 and 3 are functional group isomers of each other and both have a chiral centre.

C.text: 1 and 4 are functional group isomers of each other and both have a chiral centre.

D.text: 2 and 4 are positional isomers of each other and functional group isomers of each other.
